name: CXR-LT (CXR-LT 2024)
description: A MICCAI challenge and associated dataset/evaluation for long-tailed, multi-label, and zero-shot disease classification from chest X-rays.
reputation: A recent MICCAI challenge dataset that has garnered attention in the medical imaging community for evaluating long-tailed and zero-shot chest X‑ray classification methods.
notes: Medical-imaging benchmark with pronounced class imbalance and long-tail labels; potential privacy and label-quality caveats; non-LLM benchmark focused on radiology image classifiers and challenge-specific evaluation splits.
